name: Utsusemi
source:
He grew up an orphan until he was found by a procurer of courtesans and sold to Ohgiya. Honest and forthright of character, he is imbued with a deep kindness and treasures his companions above all others. Skilled in martial arts, he entertains activities as Kikuya's Kaguya dancing.

(Taken from the [url=https://d3p.co.jp/ohgiya/en/]official English website[/url])
